metadata.name: less
metadata.displayName: less - View file contents page by page
metadata.description: Display file contents with scrolling and search

installation.note: less is installed by default on most Linux distributions

overview.summary: less is a file viewer that displays file contents page by page with scrolling capabilities. It's more powerful than more and cat - you can scroll both forward and backward, search, and navigate efficiently. Essential for viewing large files and log files.
when_to_use: View files without loading entire content

syntax.description: Display FILE contents. Use arrow keys to scroll, / to search, q to quit.

misconceptions.title: less is the same as more
misconceptions.reality: less is more powerful than more - you can scroll backward, search, and navigate more efficiently. 'less' is actually 'more' backwards, and it's better.
misconceptions.tip: Use less instead of more - it's more powerful and allows backward scrolling.

misconceptions.title: less loads entire file
misconceptions.misconception: less loads the whole file into memory
misconceptions.reality: less loads file content as needed, making it efficient for very large files. It doesn't load the entire file at once.
misconceptions.tip: less is efficient for large files - it loads content as you scroll.

common_pitfalls.solution: Press q to quit. Press h for help to see all commands. Common: q=quit, /search, n=next, N=previous, arrow keys=scroll.

common_pitfalls.description: Using cat on large files floods terminal
common_pitfalls.solution: Use less for large files. cat is only for small files. less allows scrolling and searching.

related_commands.relationship: File viewer; less is more powerful than more
related_commands.description: View files page by page (less is better - allows backward scrolling)

related_commands.relationship: View files; cat for small files, less for large files
related_commands.description: Display entire file (use less for large files)

related_commands.relationship: View end; tail for end of files, less for full file
related_commands.description: Display last lines of files (less can view entire file)

best_practices: Use less for large files instead of cat
Press / to search, n for next match, N for previous
Use arrow keys or Page Up/Down to navigate
Use less +F to follow log files
Press h for help to see all commands
performance_tips: less is efficient - loads content as needed, not all at once
Much faster than cat for large files
No performance issues even with very large files

additional_notes.navigation: Arrow keys = scroll, Page Up/Down = page, / = search, n/N = next/prev match, q = quit, h = help
additional_notes.vs_more: less is more powerful than more - allows backward scrolling and better search
additional_notes.vs_cat: Use less for large files, cat for small files. less allows scrolling and searching.
additional_notes.follow_mode: Use +F to follow files like tail -f, but with less navigation features
additional_notes.common_usage: Very common: less file.txt (view), less -N file.txt (with line numbers), less +F log.txt (follow)
